Democracy Defender Mod Manager (DDMM), release candidate 14: *your mods, your democracy, defended.* It's still an
early build, but it's meant to be usable by anyone, not just developers.

**The DDMM Promise, in brief:** every mod is welcome (DDMM never blocks, blacklists or ranks mods or mod sites),
no account is ever needed on any site, your files stay in a folder you control, it's Apache-2.0 open source
forever, and update checks never run unless you ask.

## Quick start

1. **Download** the right file for you (see the table below).
2. **Run it.** DDMM looks for your Helldivers 2 install automatically. If Steam is in its usual place, there's
   nothing to set up.
3. **Add mods and click Deploy.** Drag in an archive or folder, or click "Add URL" and paste a link.

**Works with AyakaMods, Nexus Mods, ModWorkshop, GameBanana, GitHub, any direct link, or files already on your
disk.** Special love to the AyakaMods community ❤️, one of the best homes for Helldivers 2 modding. Go say hi:
<https://ayakamods.com/games/helldivers-2.119/>.

## Which file do I download?

| You want... | Download |
| --- | --- |
| A normal install on Windows (Start Menu shortcut, uninstaller) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.14-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows without installing anything (unzip and run) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.14-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Linux: Fedora, Nobara, openSUSE (`dnf`/`zypper`) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.14-linux-x86_64.rpm` |
| Linux: Debian, Ubuntu, Mint (`apt`) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.14-linux-amd64.deb` |
| Linux: other distros, no install (uses your desktop's graphics libraries) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.14-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux: Arch/CachyOS, or just the binary (needs WebKitGTK 4.1) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.14-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

Linux install commands, the dependencies for each distro, and fixes for a blank window or AppImage/FUSE errors
are in [Installing on Linux](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/getting-started/linux/).

**One-click install (optional):** also grab the browser extension: `ddmm-extension-chrome-1.0.0.zip`
(Chrome, Edge, Brave) or `ddmm-extension-firefox-1.0.0.zip` (Firefox). See
[One-click install](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/using/one-click-install/).

Check `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you want to verify your download.

## What's new in 2.0.0-rc.14

### Stuck on "Loading..." (#71)

If the Mods page never got past "Loading...", this is the fix. Older versions (rc.9 and earlier) had a bug where
editing a mod's options while the search box was filtering the list could save that mod into your profile twice.
Newer versions couldn't draw a list with the same mod in it twice, so the page stayed on "Loading..." forever.

- DDMM now repairs those profiles automatically when it starts: it keeps one entry per mod and tells you which mods
  it fixed. The old bug could also overwrite a different mod's entry, so afterwards check that every mod you expect
  is still in your profile.
- Editing a mod's options now only ever changes that mod.
- If the Mods page ever fails to load, you now get the error, a **Reload** button and an **Open log folder**
  button, instead of a spinner that never ends. If a popup fails to show, you get the error and a **Close** button
  instead of a wait that never ends. Either way the error is also written to the log, so it's easy to report.
- "Checking for updates..." could hang the same way for a mod with two Nexus pages. Fixed.

### Update checks

- Skipping an AyakaMods update no longer hides every later update of that mod.
- AyakaMods updates without a version number can now be skipped.

### Smaller fixes

- Saving profiles on Windows retries briefly if antivirus or a sync app has the file open, and a read-only profiles
  file now gets a clear message.
- DDMM's per-mod info files are now written in one step, so they can't be left half-written.
- **Windows:** if you moved your data folder, DDMM could very occasionally start with the default (empty) folder,
  or show the **Data Folder Not Found** screen when nothing was wrong, if two copies started at once. The browser
  extension could also look in the default folder while DDMM was saving or moving the data folder's location.
  DDMM now waits briefly for the saved location, and if it still can't be read, shows the **Data Folder Not Found**
  screen rather than using the default folder.

Thanks to @3raewsdfrw34r and @chadklatz for the reports and logs. o7

**Skipped a few?** rc.10 had important safety fixes, rc.11 fixed mod deletion, rc.12 fixed mod option dropdowns and rc.13 fixed AyakaMods update checks; see the [releases page](https://github.com/katsyk/DemocracyDefenderModManager/releases).

## Known limitations

- **Windows builds are unsigned.** Windows SmartScreen will likely show a warning the first time you run the
  installer or the app. Click **"More info" → "Run anyway"** to continue.
- **The Linux .rpm and .deb are unsigned**, so openSUSE needs `zypper install --allow-unsigned-rpm`.
- **This is still a release candidate.** Expect some rough edges, and please report what you find.
